newsitem.title: NEPAL: Nepali rupee steady v US dollar, call rates slumps.
newsitem.headline: Nepali rupee steady v US dollar, call rates slumps.

text.p: The Nepali rupee opened at 56.87/90 rupees per US dollar on Thursday, steady compared to the previous close, dealers said.
The supply seems to be good, while demand is somewhat depressed, dealers said adding that rates are expected to remain easy for about two weeks.
The rate may differ later as there is a demand of $12 million for imports of petroleum product for Nepal Oil Corporation (NOC), they said.
Nepal Rastra Bank, the kingdom's central bank, quoted its rupee-dollar rate at 56.75-57.30 rupees per dollar.
Inter-bank call money rates opened at 3.5-3.75 percent on Thursday, steady compared to the previous close, a dealer said.
